discriminate_from.crsi2_c40: the hexagonal C40 stacking of the same MX2 layer sequence; C54 is the orthorhombic Fddd variant
discriminate_from.fega3: MX2 rather than MX3 -- the Ga-Ru host holds both RuGa2 and RuGa3 and they are different prototypes
discriminate_from.hms_chimney_ladder: a simple periodic disilicide-type stacking, not an incommensurate chimney-ladder

notes: Proposed while annotating chunk 005: the Ga-Ru host is roughly half RuGa2 (Ga67Ru33 and its EPMA-averaged neighbours), which Materials Project places at Ga2Ru Fddd mp-1072429 -- the TiSi2 C54 type. The taxonomy has C40 (crsi2_c40) but neither C54 nor C11b.
Narrow-gap semiconducting intermetallic, studied alongside FeGa3-type RuGa3 in the same papers.
If accepted, consider adding mosi2_c11b alongside it: Al6Re5Si4 in the Al-Re-Si host is reported as MoSi2-type and currently has no home either.

prototype: BaFe12O19 (M-type) and its Y/W/Z block variants
formula_archetype: BaO-MeO-Fe2O3 block stackings: AFe12O19 (M), A2Me2Fe12O22 (Y), A3Me2Fe24O41 (Z)
typical_space_group: P6_3/mmc (194) for M-type, R-3m (166) for Y-type

discriminate_from.spinel: built from spinel S blocks but interleaved with R (or T) blocks containing the large Ba/Sr cation in a close-packed oxygen layer -- the cell is hexagonal and far longer than Fd-3m spinel
discriminate_from.perovskite: no corner-sharing BO6 network; the Ba-Co-Fe-O host holds both a cubic perovskite and a Y-type hexaferrite
discriminate_from.magneli_phase: block stacking of two structure types, not crystallographic shear of one

notes: Proposed while annotating chunk 005: Ba2Co2Fe12-2x(Ti,Mn)xO22 in the Ba-Co-Fe-O host is a Y-type hexaferrite and has no taxonomy entry; the rest of that host is BCFZY perovskite.
BaFe12O19 also appears as a deliberate nanoinclusion additive in the Ce-Co-Fe-Sb skutterudite host, where it is a second phase rather than the host structure.
Me is the divalent transition metal (Co, Zn, Ni, Mg); Ti/Mn substitution on the Fe sublattice is the usual carrier and anisotropy control.

discriminate_from.delafossite: PdCoO2 has triangular nets of two-coordinate Pd between CoO2 layers; PbPdO2 has square-planar PdO4 units in an orthorhombic cell with Pb in a lone-pair site
discriminate_from.tenorite: CuO is a binary monoclinic square-planar oxide with no second cation
discriminate_from.post_perovskite: not an ABO3 stoichiometry and not built from edge-sharing octahedral layers
discriminate_from.rutile: square-planar rather than octahedral coordination of the d8 cation

notes: Proposed while annotating chunk 005: the whole O-Pb-Pd host (31 samples, 8 papers) is PbPdO2 with Li, Cu or Co on the Pd site, and it matches no existing prototype.
Materials Project has PdPbO2 Imma mp-22367 with 4 ICSD references; resolve the structure there in stage 2 rather than from memory.
A narrow-gap d8 oxide with a metal-insulator transition and large thermopower; Li-for-Pd is the hole-doping variable.
